profile.headline: Software Engineer at Apple
profile.summary: Software engineer experienced in embedded Linux application development in both automotive and defense sectors.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: San Diego, California, United States · On-site
positions.description: Eliminating security critical vulnerabilities as well as hardening of the Webkit browser engine.
positions.insights: Skills: C++20 · Secure Coding · Fuzzing · HTML/CSS/Javascript · WebGL / OpenGL ES

positions.title: Staff Engineer
positions.description:
Staff software engineer working on Qualcomm's Advanced Driver Assistance Systems (ADAS).

•	Created a set of plugins in C++ for an automotive software stack to collect and store vehicle sensor data that could be retrieved on request by other software components.
•	Developed Python-based tools and scripts to visualize message traffic using post-run software logs in order to identify sources of messages drops and troubleshoot performance-related issues.
•	Coordinated and led the requirements development efforts for several planned features, identifying needs and constraints from stakeholders and developing use cases.
positions.insights: Skills: C++14 · Python · DDS · Adaptive AUTOSAR · Robot Operating System (ROS) 2 · CMake

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Wrote multi-threaded C++ networking software to command, control, and monitor avionics hardware devices, each utilizing different networking protocols.
•	Developed C++ applications within an Open Mission Systems (OMS)-based software architecture for a large, embedded Linux platform.
•	Developed Python scripts to perform automated regression and software requirements testing.
•	Maintained a Red Hat Enterprise Linux desktop port of an embedded Linux sensor management software product designed to run on specialized avionics hardware.
•	Wrote detailed software defect reports for bugs encountered during testing, providing data captures and screenshots so that the errors could be easily reproducible by other developers.
•	Performed formal software qualification testing for major software releases.

positions.title: Computer Scientist - Trainee
positions.locationName: Naval Air Station Point Mugu, Point Mugu, CA
positions.description: •	Created a MATLAB tool to analyze infrared sensor data and export summaries of the analysis into Excel.

positions.title: Cryogenics Equipment Operator
positions.description:
- Inspected quality of work as a collateral duty inspector and work center supervisor for over 25 support equipment assets deployed in over 7 countries across the Pacific.
- Provided training and mentorship to a work center of 12 personnel.
- Obtained licenses to operate and maintain 7 different models of oxygen/nitrogen based support equipment.
